answer: Require every payout to cite a three-hop payment thread whose hops have disjoint funding roots, then accept it only if that path reappears in the public river of settled transfers, the way water through karst must match a known underground course. Shared funders collapse into one path and earn once. A farm therefore pays three fresh non-kin counterparties per extra identity: one thousand aliases cost three thousand paid relationships, not one wallet split a thousand ways.
